spec.title: Failed Authoritative DNS Probes
spec.description: Current failed direct root NS probes across both resolvers and transports.

spec.title: CoreDNS SERVFAIL Rate
spec.description: SERVFAIL responses per second from in-cluster CoreDNS, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: CoreDNS Request Latency p99
spec.description: 99th percentile CoreDNS request duration, grouped by cluster.

spec.title: external-dns Registry Errors (1h)
spec.description: Errors talking to the DNS provider (registry) in the last hour, all clusters.

spec.title: external-dns Source Errors (1h)
spec.description: Errors reading route sources (HTTPRoute/Service/...) in the last hour, all clusters.

spec.title: external-dns Sync Age
spec.description: Seconds since the last provider sync and source reconcile, worst pod per cluster. A steadily climbing line means external-dns has stopped syncing.

spec.title: external-dns Records
spec.description: Records desired by sources vs records present in the registry, grouped by cluster. The two lines should sit on top of each other; a persistent gap means records are failing to sync. Zone apex records (NS, SOA) are excluded because no source can produce them.

spec.title: Resolver Metrics Age
spec.description: Worst age of the node_exporter textfile, which the collector rewrites every 15s. Healthy readings run up to about 46s because the age carries the Prometheus scrape interval on top of the write interval; red matches the KnotResolverMetricsStale alert.

spec.title: pdns-auth QPS
spec.description: Authoritative queries per second across both transports.
